beta_construction: For each seed, draw one fixed uniform master array of length 4800. Reuse that master at both strengths. For each N, reshape to (N, 4800/N) and take the arithmetic mean within each nested block.
coarsening_gate: Recompute every coarse beta as nested block means of the corresponding seed master; maximum absolute error must be exactly zero.
cross_size_metric: Two-dimensional principal-subspace overlap after common-grid embedding and reduced QR, preserving the complete 2x2 matrix and both assignment scores.
representation_fidelity: Compare linear-point and cell-average bases of the identical eigensubspace in both directions; do not normalize the cross-size score.
rank_control: Check native QR and both embedded same-N cross-pair overlaps; retain any linear-embedding leakage instead of changing the 1e-12 reference threshold.
strength_pairing: The two strengths for a given seed use the identical master profile and are paired descriptive controls, not independent disorder samples.
outcome_policy: Retain every preregistered realization, grid, method and assignment. Do not select diagonal-dominant cases or remove swapped or mixed cases.

anchor_case.role: Reuse the existing matched-profile anchor once in batch B and in the seed=6 strength pair; independently recheck it without counting it as a new realization.

batch_a_reference.role: Combine with batch A only after checking unique seed-strength keys; the anchor is absent from batch A counts.

old_candidate_role: The old seed=6 r=0.05 candidate is a different disorder realization; comparisons are descriptive and cannot be interpreted as a size-effect subtraction.
